

```{r}
library(dplyr)

Point_Loma <- Point_Loma %>%
  mutate(
    xG_for     = (`SoT for` * 0.246) + ((`Total shots for` - `SoT for`) * 0.070),
    xG_against = (`SoT against` * 0.246) + ((`Total shots against` - `SoT against`) * 0.070),
    xG_diff    = xG_for - xG_against,
    xResult    = case_when(
      xG_diff >= 0.5  ~ "W",
      xG_diff <= -0.5 ~ "L",
      TRUE            ~ "D"
    )
  )
```
